description: OpenSSF Scorecard DangerousWorkflow alerts verified as safe (2026-11-28). Health 40 Repo Selfcheck leaves these out of its Scorecard regression count; every other open DangerousWorkflow alert is counted. The alerts stay open on GitHub: they are not dismissed through the API, this file is the record. An entry matches alerts by path and by Scorecard's finding text (score prefix removed, whitespace collapsed) and covers at most `count` of them, so a new checkout with the same text in the same file is still counted. Remove an entry when its checkout changes.

entries.reason: regenerate-lock job: runs only on pull_request (not pull_request_target) for same-repository PRs authored by dependabot[bot] or renovate[bot], with permissions contents: read and persist-credentials: false. The regenerated lock leaves only as an artifact; the writer job checks out the base SHA.
publish-lock job: checks out the trusted base SHA (sparse .github/scripts) to supply the API client; it never checks out the PR head.

entries.finding: untrusted code checkout '${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.sha || github.event.repository.default_branch || github.event.workflow_run.repository.default_branch }}'
entries.reason: Checkout eligibility action: the base SHA under pull_request_target, otherwise github.sha, which for workflow_run is the default branch head. Both are trusted code.
